cropCheck.method: Release 3: template match of each quoted string over the same sampled frames (redesign-r3-20261015/demo/CROP-CHECK.json). box = the string ink box in source px of the 2880x1800 frame; yAt = its top edge at each sampled second. smallestXHeight = smallest measured x-height (source px) of any text in the stage crop window, on the poster frame.

blankScan.method: Release 3 fix round 3 (B1). Every presented frame of each locked cut at 1x (Chrome, requestVideoFrameCallback), drawn at 2880x1800, over the stage's whole 2x crop window: columns crop.x .. crop.x + 0.5 split into its two panes, rows crop.y .. crop.y + 0.5. Each pane is cut into 24x24 source-px cells from the window origin; a cell holds ink when its luma range (sampled every 2px) is >= 48, and a pane is blank when >= blankAt of its cells hold none. share = frames with neither pane blank / frames. A stage may open cropped (defaultView crop) only when share >= threshold; otherwise it opens on Fit.

phonePaneScan.method: FINAL-SPEC 2026-10-26 §2.1 / §9 #29. The blankScan cell rule over one rect: every presented frame of each locked cut at 1x (Chrome channel, requestVideoFrameCallback), drawn at 2880x1800; the w x w*5/4 source-px rect at the stage's phonePane is cut into 24x24 cells from the rect origin, a cell holds ink when its luma range (sampled every 2px) is >= 48, and a frame is blank when >= blankAt of the rect's cells hold none. share = frames not blank / frames; a phonePane is used only when share >= threshold. Fix round R3 (review 2026-10-26 B-4): stages 2 and 3 are 520px wide, so their 7px source text reads >= 9px equivalent on a 390 phone; stage 1 starts at row 380, below the scan_0140 photo box. All four rows are one run of the R3 tool; the presented-frame count varies by a few frames between runs.
